title: Tuya Cloudless — Nalunaarsuiffiit
error_https_required_body: Web Bluetooth HTTPS-imik nassatarisassaqarpoq. Uminga nalunaarsuineq Home Assistant-ikkut atorneqarpoq, HTTPS-imik atorsinnaanissaminni apeqqutissaqarpoq. HTTP-ikkut nalunaarsuineq naapertoqqissaarusiorfigineqarsinnaanngilaq.
error_browser_body: Web Bluetooth Chrome qanoq Edge Windows qanoq Android-imi atorneqassasoq. Safari qanoq Firefox Web Bluetooth nalunngissumillu atorsinnaanngikkaluarpoq.
qr_body: Web Bluetooth Chrome qanoq Edge nakorsimassaaq. QR-kode Android-iminni sinnerlugit atorsinnaanissaminnik.
qr_unavail: QR-kode nalunngissumillu atorsinnaanngikkaluarpoq. Atorneqassasoq: pip install 'tuya-cloudless[qr]'
qr_copy_label: Qanoq URL tamanna Chrome / Edge-imi periarfissigineq:
step2_hint: Tuya nalunaarusiissitit suliassarineq piginnaanerani piginnaasoqarsinnaanissaminnik (fabrikimeersorluni qanoq nalunaarusiissitit tunngasoq paasisinnaanissaminnik), taavalu 'Ujarlerit & Nalunaarusiissitit'누르십시오.
step3_ha_flow: Home Assistant nalunaarusiissitit naliliinnarpoq. Window tamanna matumminngaanneqassasoq qanoq Home Assistant-imi.
warn_invalid_ssid: ⚠ Invalid network name (max 32 bytes, no null characters).
warn_ble_disabled: ⚠ Bluetooth is disabled. Enable Bluetooth and try again.
error_browser_unsupported_body: Web Bluetooth requires Chrome or Edge (desktop or Android). Please open this page in Chrome or Edge.
err_ios_no_webbluetooth: Web Bluetooth is not available on iOS. Please open this page on a computer or Android device using Chrome or Edge.
chrome_not_installed: Chrome does not appear to be installed. Install Chrome from the Play Store and try again.
device_panel_desc: Devices found nearby appear automatically. Or use Bluetooth to scan.
no_devices_auto_found: No Tuya devices found nearby. Use Bluetooth below, or put the device in pairing mode and try again.
wifi_ap_in_progress: Pairing already in progress — wait a moment and retry.
wifi_ap_error: WiFi AP pairing failed. Check that the device is in pairing mode and try again.
wifi_ap_waiting: Credentials sent — waiting for device to join your network…
step1_desc_wifiap: Your device will connect to this network. Enter the password and click Pair.
wifi_ap_timeout: Device did not activate within 2 minutes. Check pairing mode and try again.
warn_invalid_password: ⚠ Password too long (max 63 bytes for WPA2).
err_pair_fail: Device rejected WiFi config. Check credentials and retry.
wifi_ap_nmcli_missing: WiFi nalunaarusiissitit atorsinnaanngikkaluarpoq — nmcli nalunngissumillu biissimassanngikkaluarpoq uminga Home Assistant-host-immi.
warn_no_device_selected: Nalunaarusiissitit válljejuvvanngilaq. Kingornussaminnik minnerpaamik atoruk nalunaarusiissitit válljissavat.
wifi_scan_unavailable: WiFi scanning is not available on this host — type your network name below.
wifi_scan_empty: No networks found. Try typing your network name.
